subject: SOC2: Patch-Release Confirmation & Remediation Narrative
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <security@bluenexus.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 evidence request: recent CVE closures & patch manifest

Alex —

As part of our upcoming SOC2 readiness review we need a concise package documenting Redwood's vulnerability remediation history for the last 60 days and a short attestation of SLA targets for CVE remediation. Specifically the auditor has asked for: 

- A manifest listing CVEs closed in the last 60 days, owner, date closed, and PR/patch references.
- Confirmation of scan cadence (internal and third-party) and how exceptions are handled.
- The stated SLAs for critical/high/medium and any recent SLA exceptions applied.
- A signed attestation from an engineering leader that the patch/release process was followed for the closures.

Would appreciate a single archive or links to the artifacts by EOD next week (Nov 12). We can accept Drive links and a PDF attestation.

Thanks —
Elena Ramos
Senior InfoSec Manager, BlueNexus
security@bluenexus.com

[attachment: auditor_checklist_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <security@bluenexus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: recent CVE closures & patch manifest

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We pulled together the artifacts; summary below and I attached the CSV manifest with the per-CVE metadata you requested. Key points first: 

- Scan cadence: internal static/fuzz scans run nightly; authenticated dev/stage scans weekly; third-party dynamic scans (Legacy Scanner) run every 14 days.
- SLA policy (effective 2026-01-01): Critical = 7 days to fix/mitigate (hotpatch or compensating control), High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days.
- Exceptions: Exceptions are captured in Jira SUP-xxxx records and require a compensating control + PM/Eng approver. We had two 30-day High exceptions in October for a legacy dependency sandbox; both are listed in the manifest with exception links.

What I attached:
- patch_manifest_20261031.csv — per-CVE rows: cve id, severity, first seen, assigned owner, date closed, PR/ref, mitigation type, exception_id (if any).
- remediation-playbook.pdf — excerpted playbook sections on triage -> hotpatch -> release notes 

We will provide a signed attestation PDF from Laura Bennett (Director, Security Ops) by Monday morning. For auditor traceability, the manifest includes PR links and the related Jira tickets.

If you want the artifacts packaged as a single ZIP or uploaded to your S3, tell me which you prefer and I'll get marissa to coordinate delivery.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Technical Account Lead — Security Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: patch_manifest_20261031.csv (csv)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <security@bluenexus.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: attestation and confirmation

Elena —

Quick note to attach a formal attestation (signed) confirming the remediation workflow and SLA adherence for the items listed in the attached manifest. In short: 

- I confirm Redwood's remediation cadence and SLA policy (Critical 7d / High 30d / Medium 90d) and that the entries in patch_manifest_20261031.csv were triaged and remediated according to our documented playbook, except where an exception was explicitly recorded.
- For the two High exceptions referenced by Alex, compensating controls were implemented (network segmentation + additional monitoring) and the exception approvals are recorded in the linked Jira tickets.
- This attestation is scoped to the artifacts provided (manifest + playbook excerpt) and is provided for BlueNexus' SOC2 evidence package.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: signed-attestation-laura-bennett.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Ramos <security@bluenexus.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request: confirm receipt

Alex / Laura —

Received everything, thanks. The manifest + playbook excerpt + signed attestation cover the auditor asks; we'll include these in the SOC2 package and reach out if the auditor needs any clarifications or trace logs (e.g., build IDs for the hotpatches).

One small follow-up: could you add the build IDs for the two critical hotpatch rollouts (they're already in the PRs but the auditor prefers explicit build references in a short addendum)? If you can drop that into the same Drive folder by EOD Wednesday that would be perfect.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Elena

[attachment: confirmation_receipt.txt (txt)]
